errors.text_span: секторите визуално изглеждат подредени така, че най-големите дялове са групирани последователно
errors.evidence: The description attempts to find a sorting pattern that doesn't exist. The slices are not arranged in a simple sequential order based on their values. Going counter-clockwise, the sequence 16.7%, 21.4%, 26.2%, 31.0% is increasing, but this sequence is broken by the 4.8% slice. The reference description correctly states that the sectors are not sorted.

errors.text_span: а най-малкият („Друго“) е в по-тесен сегмент
errors.evidence: This statement is tautological and adds no informational value. It is self-evident that the slice representing the smallest percentage will be the narrowest segment of the pie chart.
